page.overview:
Who is Húrin I?

Húrin I was the fifth Ruling Steward of Gondor.

Húrin was born in TA 2124, and was the son of Belegorn. He was descended from Húrin of Emyn Arnen, one of the stewards in the days of the Kings of Gondor and founder of the House of Húrin. His name was taken in the likeness of Húrin, hero of the Edain in the Elder Days and father of Túrin Turambar.

Following the death of his father in TA 2204, Húrin I became the fifth Ruling Steward of Gondor, and the fifth steward to rule during the era known as the Watchful Peace. Húrin I held the stewardship for forty years until his death in the year TA 2244 at the age of 120 years old. Húrin I was succeeded by his son Túrin I.

The name Húrin means "Steadfast" in Sindarin.
